edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE; ADJUSTMENT. The Buyer shall pay the Seller the purchase price set forth on Schedule 1.1 (the “Purchase Price”) for the Shares in immediately available funds at Closing, subject to adjustment as follows: (a) not later than three Business Days prior to Closing, Seller shall deliver to Buyer a good-faith estimated closing statement setting forth Seller’s estimate of Closing Net Working Capital, Closing Cash, Closing Indebtedness, and Transaction Expenses; (b) the amount payable at Closing shall be adjusted upward by the amount, if any, by which estimated Closing Net Working Capital exceeds the Target Net Working Capital, and downward by the amount, if any, by which estimated Closing Net Working Capital is less than the Target Net Working Capital, and further adjusted dollar-for-dollar for Closing Cash, Closing Indebtedness, and unpaid Transaction Expenses; (c) within 75 days after Closing, Buyer may deliver a proposed final closing statement; (d) Seller shall have 30 days to review and object to Buyer’s proposed final closing statement; (e) any disputed items not resolved within 20 days shall be submitted to an independent nationally recognized accounting firm mutually selected by the parties, whose determination shall be limited to the disputed items and shall be final and binding absent manifest error; and (f) any final adjustment shall be paid by the applicable party within five Business Days after final determination. All calculations shall be made in accordance with GAAP applied consistently with the Company’s past practices, except as otherwise expressly set forth on Schedule 1.1.
edits.name: Purchase price adjustment mechanics

edits.text: 2. CLOSING; DELIVERABLES. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing, or on such other date as the parties may agree in writing, subject to satisfaction or waiver of the conditions to Closing set forth in this Agreement. At Closing: (a) Seller shall deliver customary stock powers or other instruments of transfer, resignations of directors and officers requested by Buyer at least five Business Days prior to Closing, payoff letters and lien releases for Closing Indebtedness to be paid at Closing, a certificate confirming satisfaction of Seller’s closing conditions, an executed IRS Form W-9 or applicable withholding certificate, and such other customary instruments as are reasonably necessary to transfer the Shares; and (b) Buyer shall deliver the Closing payment, evidence of any required payoff payments made on Seller’s behalf, a certificate confirming satisfaction of Buyer’s closing conditions, and such other customary instruments as are reasonably necessary to consummate the transaction. Each party’s obligation to close shall be conditioned on the other party’s representations being true and correct in all material respects as of Closing, compliance in all material respects with pre-Closing covenants, receipt of required approvals, and absence of any order prohibiting the Closing.
edits.name: Closing deliverables and conditions

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. Seller represents that the financial statements delivered to Buyer fairly present in all material respects the financial condition and results of operations of the Company for the periods indicated, in accordance with GAAP applied consistently with the Company’s past practices, subject to normal year-end adjustments and the notes thereto. Seller further represents that, to Seller’s knowledge, the Company is not subject to any material undisclosed liabilities other than liabilities reflected or reserved against in the financial statements, liabilities incurred in the ordinary course of business since the date of the most recent balance sheet, liabilities arising under executory portions of contracts made available to Buyer, and liabilities expressly disclosed on the schedules to this Agreement. The foregoing knowledge qualifier shall not apply to the fundamental representations, capitalization, due authorization, title to the Shares, taxes, or the accuracy of the financial statements.
edits.name: Representations and knowledge qualifier

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. From and after Closing, Seller shall indemnify Buyer and its affiliates, officers, directors, members, managers, employees, successors, and assigns against losses arising from: (a) any breach of Seller’s representations and warranties; (b) any breach of Seller’s covenants; and (c) any liabilities expressly identified as retained liabilities on Schedule 4.1. Buyer shall indemnify Seller and its affiliates, officers, directors, members, managers, employees, successors, and assigns against losses arising from: (i) any breach of Buyer’s representations, warranties, or covenants; and (ii) the ownership or operation of the Company after Closing, except to the extent subject to Seller’s indemnification obligations. General representations shall survive for 12 months after Closing; fundamental representations, tax representations, and claims based on fraud shall survive for the applicable statute of limitations, subject to any shorter period expressly agreed by the parties. Seller shall have no liability for breaches of general representations until aggregate indemnifiable losses exceed 1.0% of the Purchase Price, after which Seller shall be liable only for amounts in excess of such threshold; Seller’s aggregate liability for breaches of general representations shall not exceed 10.0% of the Purchase Price. The foregoing basket and cap shall not apply to breaches of fundamental representations, tax representations, covenants requiring performance after Closing, retained liabilities, or fraud. Indemnification shall be the parties’ exclusive monetary remedy after Closing, except for fraud, equitable remedies, and claims under any ancillary agreement. The indemnified party shall provide prompt written notice of claims, reasonably cooperate in defense, and permit the indemnifying party to control third-party claim defense with counsel reasonably acceptable to the indemnified party, provided that the indemnifying party may not settle any claim imposing non-monetary obligations or admitting wrongdoing without the indemnified party’s consent, not to be unreasonably withheld.
edits.name: Indemnity package and limitations

edits.text: Schedule 1.1 — Purchase Price and Adjustment Principles. Purchase Price: [●]. Target Net Working Capital: [●]. Closing Cash: cash and cash equivalents of the Company as of immediately prior to Closing, calculated in accordance with GAAP applied consistently with past practice. Closing Indebtedness: indebtedness for borrowed money, unpaid accrued interest, breakage costs, capital lease obligations, deferred purchase price obligations, declared but unpaid dividends, and similar obligations, excluding trade payables included in Closing Net Working Capital. Transaction Expenses: unpaid fees, costs, bonuses, change-of-control payments, broker fees, legal fees, accounting fees, and other expenses incurred by or on behalf of Seller or the Company in connection with the transactions, to the extent unpaid as of Closing and not included in Closing Net Working Capital. Closing Net Working Capital: current assets minus current liabilities of the Company as of immediately prior to Closing, excluding Closing Cash, Closing Indebtedness, Transaction Expenses, tax assets and liabilities, and any items otherwise expressly excluded by this Agreement, calculated in accordance with GAAP applied consistently with past practice.
edits.name: Schedule 1.1

edits.text: Schedule 4.1 — Retained Liabilities. Retained liabilities shall consist only of the following, to the extent existing as of or arising from periods prior to Closing and not otherwise reflected in the final purchase price adjustment: (a) Seller transaction expenses; (b) Seller-level taxes; (c) indebtedness required to be paid at Closing but not paid from Closing proceeds; and (d) any liabilities expressly identified by item on this Schedule 4.1. For clarity, ordinary course operating liabilities of the Company included in Closing Net Working Capital shall not constitute retained liabilities.
edits.name: Schedule 4.1
